eyebrow: SGA — shared by the whole instance
code:
SGA (one per instance, shared)
  Database buffer cache
    cached data blocks
  Shared pool
    parsed SQL + execution plans
  Redo log buffer
    redo entries before LGWR flushes them
caption: Every server process can read the SGA — that's what makes it 'system global.'

code:
PGA (one per server process, private)
  sort areas
    ORDER BY, GROUP BY, hash joins
  cursor state
    session-specific, not shared

Not visible to any other session.
caption: SGA is shared; PGA is not — a split SQL Server's buffer pool doesn't make.
